title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六: 穆宗上
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六: 穆宗上 Volume 6 Annals 6: Muzong 1

sentences.zh: 穆宗上

translations.literal: Muzong, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Muzong, Part One

sentences.zh: 穆宗孝安敬正皇帝，諱璟，小字述律。

translations.literal: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright — personal name Jing, courtesy name Shulü.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright, whose personal name was Jing and whose courtesy name was Shulü.

sentences.zh: 太宗皇帝長子，母曰靖安皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Taizong; his mother was Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan.
translations.idiomatic: Eldest son of Emperor Taizong, born to Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan.

sentences.zh: 會同二年，封壽安王。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huitong he was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huitong he received the title Prince of Shou'an.

sentences.zh: 天祿五年秋九月癸亥，世宗遇害。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianlu, in the ninth month of autumn, on guihai day, Shizong met with assassination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianlu, on guihai day in the ninth month of autumn, Shizong was assassinated.

sentences.zh: 逆臣察割等伏誅。

translations.literal: The treacherous ministers Chage and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Chage and his accomplices were put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，即皇帝位，群臣上尊號曰天順皇帝，改元應歷。

translations.literal: On dingmao day he ascended the imperial throne; the assembled ministers offered the elevated title Emperor of Heavenly Accord, and the era name was changed to Yingli.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day he took the throne; the court invested him as Emperor of Heavenly Accord and changed the era name to Yingli.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，如南京。

translations.literal: On wuchen day he went to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣劉承訓告哀於漢。

translations.literal: That month Liu Chengxun was dispatched to announce the mourning to Han.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Chengxun was sent to Han to announce the Emperor's bereavement.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，漢、周、南唐各遣使來吊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Han, Zhou, and Southern Tang each sent envoys to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Han, Zhou, and Southern Tang each dispatched envoys of condolence.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔朝會依嗣聖皇帝故事，用漢禮。

translations.literal: On yihai day an edict ordered court assemblies to follow the precedent of Emperor Sisheng, using Han ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict directed that court assemblies follow the precedent of Emperor Sisheng and adopt Han court ritual.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，漢遣使獻弓矢、鞍馬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, Han sent envoys presenting bows and arrows, saddles, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, Han sent envoys with bows and arrows, saddles, and horses.

sentences.zh: 壬子，鐵驪、鼻骨德皆來貢。

translations.literal: On renzi day Tieli and Bigude both came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Tieli and Bigude both brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊午朔，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書，及進犀兕甲萬屬。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the wuwu new moon of the first month of spring, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter and presenting ten thousand suits of rhinoceros-hide armor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the wuwu new moon of the first spring month, Southern Tang sent envoys with a wax-sealed letter and ten thousand suits of rhinoceros-hide armor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太尉忽古質謀逆，伏誅。

translations.literal: On renxu day Grand Commandant Huguzhi plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Grand Commandant Huguzhi was executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，女直來貢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guimao day, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai day, Southern Tang dispatched envoys with a wax-sealed letter.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On dingmao day they again sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys again.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以耶律撻烈為南院大王。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Yelü Talie was appointed Great King of the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Yelü Talie was made Great King of the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the bingxu new moon of the fourth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，鐵驪進鷹鶻。

translations.literal: On jihai day Tieli presented hunting hawks and falcons.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Tieli presented hawks and falcons for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，視朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen new moon, he held court.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month the Emperor held court.

sentences.zh: 壬午，南唐遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On renwu day Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，國舅政事令蕭眉古得、宣政殿學士李澣等謀南奔，事覺，詔暴其罪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Chief Councillor of State Affairs Meigude of the imperial maternal uncle's household, Academician of the Hall of Promulgating Governance Li Han, and others plotted to flee south; when the plot was discovered, an edict publicly proclaimed their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Chief Councillor Meigude of the imperial maternal uncle's household, Hall of Promulgating Governance academician Li Han, and others plotted to flee south; the plot was discovered, and an edict publicly proclaimed their crimes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，祭天地。

translations.literal: On yiwei day heaven and earth were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，漢為周所侵，遣使求援，命中臺省右相高模翰赴之。

translations.literal: On renyin day Han, invaded by Zhou, sent envoys requesting aid; the Emperor ordered Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Gao Mohan to go to their assistance.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys begging aid; the Emperor ordered Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Gao Mohan to their relief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命乳媼之兄曷魯世為阿速石烈夷離堇。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the elder brother of the wet nurse, Helu Shi, was appointed yilijin of the Asu Shilie.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Helu Shi, elder brother of the wet nurse, was appointed yilijin of the Asu Shilie.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，政事令婁國、林牙敵烈、侍中神都、郎君海裏等謀亂，就執。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized where they stood.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，眉古得、婁國等伏誅，杖李澣而釋之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and the others were executed; Li Han was flogged and released.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Li Han was flogged and then released.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅朔，雲州進嘉禾四莖，二穗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, Yun Prefecture presented auspicious grain with four stalks and two ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, Yun Prefecture reported auspicious grain of four stalks bearing two ears.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔以先平察割日，用白黑羊、玄酒祭天，歲以為常。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered that on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, white and black sheep and dark wine be used to sacrifice to heaven — established as an annual rite.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict established an annual rite: on the anniversary of Chage's defeat, heaven was to be sacrificed to with white and black sheep and dark wine.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，獵炭山。

translations.literal: On renxu day he hunted at Mount Tanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the Emperor hunted at Mount Tanshan.

sentences.zh: 祭天。

translations.literal: He sacrificed to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He performed the heaven sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，敵烈部來貢。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the Dilie tribe came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Dilie tribe brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，漢遣使進葡萄酒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiashen new moon, Han sent envoys presenting grape wine.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the jiashen new moon of the tenth month, Han sent envoys with grape wine.

sentences.zh: 甲午，司徒老古等獻白雉。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Grand Tutor Laogu and others presented white pheasants.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Grand Tutor Laogu and others presented white pheasants in tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊申，回鶻及轄戛斯皆遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Uyghurs and Kirghiz both dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Uyghurs and Kirghiz both sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑朔，視朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guichou new moon, he held court.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor held court.

sentences.zh: 己巳，地震。

translations.literal: On jisi day there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 己卯，日南至，始用舊制行拜日禮。

translations.literal: On jimao day, at the winter solstice, the old rite of bowing to the sun was performed for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, at the winter solstice, the court performed the old sun-bowing rite for the first time.

sentences.zh: 朔州民進黑兔。

translations.literal: The people of Shuozhou presented a black rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners of Shuozhou presented a black rabbit.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未朔，高模翰及漢兵圍晉州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guiwei new moon, Gao Mohan and Han troops besieged Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the twelfth month, Gao Mohan and Han forces laid siege to Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以生日，飯僧，釋系囚。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, on his birthday, he fed the monks and released prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, his birthday, the Emperor fed the monks and released prisoners.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiachen day he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 祀天地。

translations.literal: He sacrificed to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: He performed sacrifices to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，明王安端薨。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Prince Ming'an Anduan died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Prince Ming'an Anduan passed away.

sentences.zh: 三年春閏正月壬午朔，漢以高模翰卻周軍，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the intercalary first month of spring, on the renwu new moon, because Gao Mohan had repelled the Zhou army, Han sent envoys to offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the renwu new moon of the intercalary first spring month, Han sent envoys to give thanks after Gao Mohan had driven back the Zhou army.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥朔，詔用嗣聖皇帝舊璽。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the xinhai new moon, an edict ordered use of Emperor Sisheng's old imperial seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the second month an edict directed that Emperor Sisheng's old imperial seal be used.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太保敵烈修易州城，鎮州以兵來挑戰，卻之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Grand Guardian Dilie repaired the walls of Yizhou city; Zhen Prefecture sent troops to challenge him, and he repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Grand Guardian Dilie repaired the walls of Yizhou; when Zhen Prefecture sent troops to challenge him, he drove them back.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰朔，南唐遣使來貢，因附書於漢，詔達之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the gengchen new moon, Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute and attached a letter for Han; an edict ordered it delivered.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the third month Southern Tang sent tribute envoys with a letter for Han; the Emperor ordered it forwarded.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，如應州擊鞠。

translations.literal: On gengyin day he went to Ying Prefecture to play cuju.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor went to Ying Prefecture to play cuju.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，漢遣使進球衣及馬。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Han sent envoys presenting ball-playing gear and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Han sent envoys with ball-playing equipment and horses.

sentences.zh: 庚子，觀漁於神德湖。

translations.literal: On gengzi day he watched fishing at Shende Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor watched the fishing at Shende Lake.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, Tieli came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on gengshen day, Tieli brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，漢遣使言石晉樹先帝《聖德神功碑》為周人所毀，請再刻，許之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renyin day, Han sent envoys reporting that the Sacred Virtue and Divine Merit stele erected by Later Jin for the late emperor had been destroyed by the people of Zhou, and requesting that it be carved again; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renyin day, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had destroyed the Sacred Virtue and Divine Merit stele Later Jin had erected for the late emperor, and asking that it be recarved; the Emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，應天皇太后崩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, the Empress Dowager Yingtian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, Empress Dowager Yingtian passed away.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，不視朝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor withdrew from court.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，以生日，釋囚。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renzi day, on his birthday, prisoners were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi day, his birthday, the Emperor released prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己未，漢遣使求援。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Han sent envoys requesting aid.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Han sent envoys begging military aid.

sentences.zh: 三河烏古、吐蕃、吐谷渾、鼻骨德皆遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Sanhe Wugu, Tibetans, Tuyuhun, and Bigude all dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Sanhe Wugu, Tibetans, Tuyuhun, and Bigude all sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，漢遣使貢藥。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Han sent envoys presenting medicines.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Han sent envoys with medicines.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，命太師唐骨德治大行皇太后園陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor Tang Gude was ordered to oversee the tomb park of the late Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor Tang Gude was ordered to oversee the tomb park of the late Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 李胡子宛、郎君嵇幹、敵烈謀反，事覺，辭逮太平王罨撒葛、林牙華割、郎君新羅等，皆執之。

translations.literal: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others — all were seized.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was uncovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others, and all were arrested.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，謚皇太后曰貞烈，葬祖陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the late empress dowager was given the posthumous title Chaste and Resolute and was buried at the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, the late empress dowager was posthumously titled Chaste and Resolute and interred at the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 漢遣使來會。

translations.literal: Han sent envoys to attend the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Han dispatched envoys to attend the burial rites.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕奉聖州。

translations.literal: That winter the court encamped at Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以南京水，詔免今歲租。

translations.literal: Because of flooding at the Southern Capital, an edict remitted that year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding at the Southern Capital prompted an edict remitting that year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊寅，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on wuyin day, the Uyghurs came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on wuyin day in the first month of spring, the Uyghurs brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，華割、嵇幹等伏誅，宛及罨撒葛皆釋之。

translations.literal: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and the others were executed; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.

sentences.zh: 是月，周主威殂，養子晉王柴榮嗣立。

translations.literal: That month Zhou ruler Wei died; his adopted son, Prince of Jin Chai Rong, succeeded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou's ruler Guo Wei died, and his adopted son, Prince of Jin Chai Rong, succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午朔，周攻漢，命政事令耶律敵祿援之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the bingwu new moon, Zhou attacked Han; Chief Councillor Yelü Dilu was ordered to go to their aid.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the second month, as Zhou attacked Han, Chief Councillor Yelü Dilu was ordered to their relief.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，漢遣使進茶藥。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Han sent envoys presenting tea and medicines.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Han sent envoys with tea and medicines.

sentences.zh: 幸南京。

translations.literal: He visited the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙亥，忻、代二州叛漢，遣南院大王撻烈助敵祿討之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yihai day, Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled against Han; Great King of the Southern Court Talie was ordered to assist Dilu in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fifth month on yihai day, when Xin and Dai prefectures rebelled against Han, Great King of the Southern Court Talie was ordered to join Dilu in suppressing the revolt.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，撻烈敗周將符彥卿於忻口。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Talie defeated Zhou general Fu Yanqing at Xinkou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Talie routed Zhou general Fu Yanqing at Xinkou.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，撻烈獻所獲。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Talie presented what he had captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Talie presented his captives and booty.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，漢民有為遼軍誤掠者，遣使來請，詔悉歸之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiyou day, Han civilians had been mistakenly seized by Liao troops; Han sent envoys requesting their return, and an edict ordered all of them restored.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on yiyou day, when Han civilians had been mistakenly seized by Liao troops, Han sent envoys asking their return, and an edict ordered every one of them restored.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，漢為周人所侵，遣使來告。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, Han, invaded by the people of Zhou, sent envoys to report it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys to report the attack.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，彰國軍節度使蕭敵烈，太保許從赟奏忻、代二州捷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Zhangguo Army Military Governor Xiao Dilie and Grand Tutor Xu Congyun memorialized the victory at Xin and Dai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Zhangguo Army Military Governor Xiao Dilie and Grand Tutor Xu Congyun reported the victory at Xin and Dai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉朔，謁祖陵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, he visited the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，漢遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Han sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Han sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕杏堝。

translations.literal: That winter the court encamped at Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛未朔，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on the xinwei new moon of the first month of spring, Bigude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the xinwei new moon of the first spring month, Bigude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the gengzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the second month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，漢遣使請上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Han sent envoys requesting that an elevated title be conferred on the Emperor; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Han sent envoys asking that an elevated title be conferred on the Emperor; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，如潭。

translations.literal: On renxu day he went to Tan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the Emperor went to Tan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，周侵漢，漢遣使求援。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Zhou invaded Han, and Han sent envoys requesting aid.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on jiyou day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys begging aid.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命郎君蕭海璃世為北府宰相。

translations.literal: On guichou day langjun Xiao Hailishi was appointed Northern Chancellery Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day langjun Xiao Hailishi was made Northern Chancellery Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 秋九月庚辰，漢主有疾，遣使來告。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen day, the Han ruler fell ill and sent envoys to report it.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han fell ill and sent envoys to announce it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，女直來貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renshen day, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on renshen day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，謁太宗廟。

translations.literal: On dinghai day he visited Taizong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor visited Taizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，南唐遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未朔，漢主崇殂，子承鈞遣使來告，且求嗣立。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yiwei new moon, Han ruler Chong died; his son Liu Chengjun sent envoys to announce the death and request recognition of his succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the eleventh month Han's ruler Liu Chong died; his son Liu Chengjun sent envoys announcing the death and asking that his succession be recognized.

sentences.zh: 遣使吊祭，遂封冊之。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and perform the investiture; he was thereupon enfeoffed and invested.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent envoys to mourn and invest the new ruler, and Liu Chengjun was thereupon enfeoffed and confirmed in succession.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑朔，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yichou new moon, he visited Taizu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，漢遣使來議軍事。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Han sent envoys to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Han sent envoys to consult on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 六年夏五月丁酉，謁懷陵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the fifth month of summer, on dingyou day, he visited Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on dingyou day in the fifth month of summer, the Emperor visited Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，漢遣使來議軍事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi day, Han sent envoys to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiazi day, Han sent envoys to consult on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，不視朝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor withdrew from court.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，謁祖陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, the Emperor visited the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day renchen, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, on renchen day, the Biegude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未朔，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On the jiwei new moon of the twelfth month, he visited Emperor Taizu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the twelfth month he visited Emperor Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月庚子，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on day gengzi of the first month of spring, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on gengzi day of the first spring month, the Biegude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: On day xinyou in the second month, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the second month Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.

sentences.zh: 辛未，駐蹕潢河。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, he halted at the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day he encamped at the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午朔，還上京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuwu new moon, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the wuwu new moon of the fourth month, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 初，女巫肖古上延年藥方，當用男子膽和之。

translations.literal: Previously, the witch Xiao Gu submitted a recipe for longevity medicine that required human gall to be mixed in.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the witch Xiao Gu had submitted a recipe for longevity medicine that called for human gall to be mixed in.

sentences.zh: 不數年，殺人甚多，至是，覺其妄，辛巳，射殺之。

translations.literal: Within a few years many people had been killed; at this point he realized the fraud, and on day xinsi he shot and killed her.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years a great many people had been killed; when he realized the deception, on xinsi day he shot and killed her.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，漢遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On day xinmao in the fifth month, Han sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the fifth month Han sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰朔，周遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month, Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the sixth month Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 南唐遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Southern Tang sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，周遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On day jiwei in the eighth month, Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the eighth month Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 是秋，不聽政。

translations.literal: That autumn, he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，獵於七鷹山。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day gengshen, he hunted at Seven Eagle Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on gengshen day, he hunted at Seven Eagle Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，詔大臣曰：「有罪者，法當刑。

translations.literal: On day dingsi in the twelfth month, he issued an edict to the ministers, saying, "Those who are guilty should be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the twelfth month he issued an edict to the ministers: "Those who commit crimes should be punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 朕或肆怒，濫及無辜，卿等切諫，無或面從。

translations.literal: If I give way to anger and it extends to the innocent, you must remonstrate urgently and not merely agree to my face.
translations.idiomatic: If I give way to rage and harm the innocent, you must remonstrate forcefully and not merely agree to my face.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，還上京。

translations.literal: " On day xinsi, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi day he returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 八年春二月乙丑，駐蹕潢河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, on day yichou of the second month of spring, he halted at the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on yichou day of the second spring month, he encamped at the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，南京留守蕭思溫攻下沿邊州縣，遣人勞之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day jiayin, Nanjing garrison commander Xiao Siwen captured border prefectures and counties, and the Emperor sent men to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on jiayin day in the fourth month, Nanjing garrison commander Xiao Siwen captured border prefectures and counties, and the Emperor sent men to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 五月，周陷束城縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhou captured Dongcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zhou took Dongcheng County.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，蕭思溫請益兵，乞駕幸燕。

translations.literal: On day xinwei in the sixth month, Xiao Siwen requested reinforcements and pleaded that the Emperor come in person to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the sixth month Xiao Siwen asked for reinforcements and pleaded that the Emperor come in person to Yan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，獵於拽剌山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, he hunted at Zhaila Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month he hunted at Zhaila Mountain.

sentences.zh: 迄於九月，射鹿諸山，不視朝。

translations.literal: Through the ninth month he shot deer on various mountains and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: Through the ninth month he hunted deer on various mountains and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，漢遣使來告周復來侵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day xinyou, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had invaded again.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, on xinyou day, Han sent envoys reporting that Zhou had invaded again.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，使再至。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the envoys came again.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the envoys came again.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，又至。

translations.literal: On day gengchen in the twelfth month, they came again.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day in the twelfth month they came again.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月戊辰，駐蹕潢河。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, on day wuchen of the first month of spring, he halted at the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on wuchen day of the first spring month, he encamped at the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，周來侵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day bingxu, Zhou invaded.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on bingxu day in the fourth month, Zhou invaded.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以南京留守蕭思溫為兵馬都總管，擊之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Xiao Siwen, Nanjing garrison commander, was appointed grand commander of army and horse and sent to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xiao Siwen, Nanjing garrison commander, was made grand commander of army and horse and sent to attack them.

sentences.zh: 是月，周拔益津、瓦橋、淤口三關。

translations.literal: That month, Zhou captured the three passes of Yijin, Waqiao, and Yukou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou took the three passes of Yijin, Waqiao, and Yukou.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳朔，陷瀛、莫二州。

translations.literal: On the yisi new moon of the fifth month, Zhou captured Ying and Mo prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the fifth month Zhou captured Ying and Mo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，如南京。

translations.literal: On day guihai, he went to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，周兵退。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Zhou army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Zhou army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥朔，視朝。

translations.literal: On the yihai new moon of the sixth month, he held court.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai new moon of the sixth month he held court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復容城縣。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Rongcheng County was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Rongcheng County was recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，西幸，如懷州。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, he went west on tour to Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he went west on tour to Huai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，周主榮殂，子宗訓立。

translations.literal: That month, Zhou's ruler Rong died and his son Zongxun succeeded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou's ruler Rong died and his son Zongxun succeeded to the throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，發南京軍戍范陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, he sent Nanjing troops to garrison Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month he sent Nanjing troops to garrison Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月戊寅，還上京。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on day wuyin, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the twelfth month, on wuyin day, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，王子敵烈、前宣徽使海思及蕭達干等謀反，事覺，鞫之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Prince Dilie, former Xuanhui commissioner Haisi, Xiao Dagan, and others plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered they were interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince Dilie, former Xuanhui commissioner Haisi, Xiao Dagan, and others plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered they were put to interrogation.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祀天地、祖考，告逆黨事敗。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors, announcing that the rebel conspiracy had failed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth and the imperial ancestors, announcing that the rebel conspiracy had failed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，召群臣議時政。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, he summoned the ministers to discuss current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day he summoned the ministers to discuss current affairs.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月，周殿前都點檢趙匡胤廢周自立，建國號宋。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, in the first month of spring, Zhou's Palace Front inspector Zhao Kuangyin deposed Zhou and enthroned himself, founding the state of Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the first spring month, Zhou's Palace Front inspector Zhao Kuangyin deposed Zhou and enthroned himself, founding the state of Song.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙巳，謁懷陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on day yisi, he visited Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on yisi day in the fifth month, he visited Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬子，漢以潞州歸附來告。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Han sent word that Luzhou had submitted to them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Han sent word that Luzhou had submitted to them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，至自懷陵。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, he returned from Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day he returned from Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，漢以宋兵圍石州來告，遣大同軍節度使阿剌率四部往援，詔蕭思溫以三部兵助之。

translations.literal: On day gengshen in the sixth month, Han reported that Song troops were besieging Shizhou; Datong Army military governor Ala was dispatched with four tribes to the rescue, and Xiao Siwen was ordered to assist with troops from three tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the sixth month Han reported that Song troops were besieging Shizhou; Datong Army military governor Ala was dispatched with four tribes to the rescue, and Xiao Siwen was ordered to assist with troops from three tribes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，宋兵陷石州，潞州復叛，漢使來告。

translations.literal: On the jihai new moon of the seventh month of autumn, Song troops captured Shizhou and Luzhou rebelled again; Han sent envoys with the news.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the seventh autumn month Song troops took Shizhou and Luzhou rebelled again; Han sent envoys with the news.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，政事令耶律壽遠、太保楚阿不等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Affairs commissioner Yelü Shouyuan, Grand Guardian Chu Abu, and others plotted rebellion and were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Affairs commissioner Yelü Shouyuan, Grand Guardian Chu Abu, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 以酒脯祠天地於黑山。

translations.literal: He sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at Black Mountain with wine and dried meat.
translations.idiomatic: At Black Mountain he offered wine and dried meat in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 八月，如秋山，幸懷州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, he went to Autumn Mountain and visited Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he went to Autumn Mountain and visited Huai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以鎮茵石狻猊擊殺近侍古哥。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, he killed his attendant Guge by striking him with a stone lion from the zhenyins screen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he killed his attendant Guge by striking him with a stone lion from the zhenyins screen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，李胡子喜隱謀反，辭連李胡，下獄死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day bingzi, Li Huzi Xiyin plotted rebellion; testimony implicated Li Hu, who was imprisoned and died there.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on bingzi day Li Huzi Xiyin plotted rebellion; testimony implicated Li Hu, who was imprisoned and died in custody.

sentences.zh: 十一月，海思獄中上書，陳便宜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Haisi submitted a memorial from prison setting forth practical proposals.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Haisi submitted a memorial from prison setting forth practical proposals.

sentences.zh: 十一年春二月丙寅，釋喜隱。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, on day bingyin of the second month of spring, Xiyin was released.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on bingyin day in the second spring month, Xiyin was released.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，司徒烏裏只子叠剌哥誣告其父謀反，復詐乘傳及殺行人，以其父請，杖而釋之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Wulizhi's son Dielage falsely accused his father of plotting rebellion and also abused the imperial relay system and killed travelers; at his father's plea he was flogged and released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wulizhi's son Dielage falsely accused his father of plotting rebellion and also abused the imperial relay system and killed passersby; at his father's plea he was flogged and released.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，蕭思溫奏老人星見，乞行赦宥。

translations.literal: On day bingchen in the third month, Xiao Siwen reported that the Old Man Star had appeared and asked that an amnesty be proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the third month Xiao Siwen reported that the Old Man Star had appeared and asked that an amnesty be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲子朔，如潢河。

translations.literal: On the jiazi new moon of the intercalary month, he went to the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the intercalary month he went to the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guisi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the guisi new moon of the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，射鹿，不視朝。

translations.literal: That month, he hunted deer and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: That month he hunted deer and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，司天王白、李正等進歷。

translations.literal: On day yihai in the fifth month, Astronomical Bureau director Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others presented the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day in the fifth month Astronomical Bureau director Wang Bai, Li Zheng, and others presented the calendar.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，赦。

translations.literal: On day jiawu in the sixth month, he proclaimed an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the sixth month he proclaimed an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，歲星犯月。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Jupiter trespassed the moon.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, Jupiter trespassed the moon.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月甲戌，夜觀燈。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, on day jiaxu of the first month of spring, he viewed lanterns at night.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on jiaxu day of the first spring month, he viewed lanterns at night.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑朔，以御史大夫蕭護思為北院樞密使，賜對衣、鞍馬。

translations.literal: On the jichou new moon of the second month, Censor-in-chief Xiao Husi was made Northern Court Privy Commissioner and given paired robes, a saddle, and a horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the second month Censor-in-chief Xiao Husi was made Northern Court Privy Commissioner and given paired robes, a saddle, and a horse.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚午，以旱，命左右以水相沃，頃之，果雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on day gengwu, because of drought he ordered his attendants to douse one another with water; before long rain indeed fell.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on gengwu day in the fifth month, because of drought he ordered his attendants to douse one another with water; before long rain indeed fell.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，祠木葉山及潢河。

translations.literal: On day jiawu in the sixth month, he sacrificed at Muye Mountain and the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the sixth month he sacrificed at Muye Mountain and the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 秋，如黑山、赤山射鹿。

translations.literal: That autumn, he hunted deer at Black Mountain and Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he hunted deer at Black Mountain and Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月，自丁巳晝夜酣飲者九日。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in the first month of spring, from dingsi day he drank heavily day and night for nine days.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in the first spring month, from dingsi day he drank heavily day and night for nine days.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宋欲城益津關，命南京留守高勛、統軍使崔廷勛以兵擾之。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, as Song sought to fortify Yijin Pass, he ordered Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun and army commander Cui Tingxun to harass them with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, as Song sought to fortify Yijin Pass, he ordered Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun and army commander Cui Tingxun to harass them with troops.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，殺獸人海裏。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, he killed beast keeper Haili.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he killed beast keeper Haili.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，漢遣使來告，欲巡邊僥，乞張聲援。

translations.literal: On day gengyin in the second month, Han sent envoys reporting that they wished to patrol the border and asking that Liao make a show of support.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the second month Han sent envoys reporting that they wished to patrol the border and asking that Liao make a show of support.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，如潢河。

translations.literal: On day renchen, he went to the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day he went to the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，觀群臣射，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, he watched the ministers shoot and granted gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he watched the ministers shoot and granted gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，老人星見。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Old Man Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，殺鹿人彌裏吉，梟其首以示掌鹿者。

translations.literal: On the guichou new moon of the third month, he killed deer keeper Miliji and had his head displayed as a warning to the deer keepers.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the third month he killed deer keeper Miliji and had his head displayed as a warning to the deer keepers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，獵於潢河。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day renyin, he hunted at the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on renyin day in the fourth month, he hunted at the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，視斡朗改國所進花鹿生麛。

translations.literal: On day renxu in the fifth month, he inspected a newborn spotted-deer fawn presented by Wolanguo.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the fifth month he inspected a newborn spotted-deer fawn presented by Wolanguo.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，近侍傷獐，杖殺之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei in the sixth month, an attendant injured a roe deer, and the Emperor had him beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the sixth month an attendant injured a roe deer, and the Emperor had him beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 甲申，殺獐人霞馬。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, he killed roe deer keeper Xiamar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he killed roe deer keeper Xiamar.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔諸路錄囚。

translations.literal: On day renchen, he ordered every circuit to review prisoners on record.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day he ordered every circuit to review prisoners on record.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，漢以宋侵來告。

translations.literal: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh month of autumn, Han reported a Song invasion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh autumn month Han reported a Song invasion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，薦時羞於廟。

translations.literal: On day yichou, he offered seasonal delicacies at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day he offered seasonal delicacies at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，以生日，縱五坊鷹鶻。

translations.literal: On day jiashen in the eighth month, on his birthday, he released the hawks and falcons of the Five Wards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the eighth month, on his birthday, he released the hawks and falcons of the Five Wards.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸近山，呼鹿射之，旬有七日而後返。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, he went to nearby mountains, called deer, and shot them; only after seventeen days did he return.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he went to nearby mountains, called deer, and shot them; only after seventeen days did he return.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On the gengxu new moon of the ninth month, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with a blue ox and a white horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the ninth month he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with a blue ox and a white horse.

sentences.zh: 飲於野次，終夕乃罷。

translations.literal: He drank at a field encampment and did not stop until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: He drank at a field encampment and kept at it all night long.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以酒脯祭天地，復終夜酣飲。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and dried meat, then drank heavily through the night again.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and dried meat, then drank heavily through the night again.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，漢以宋侵來告。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day bingshen, Han reported a Song invasion.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on bingshen day, Han reported a Song invasion.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，獵，飲於虞人之家，凡四日。

translations.literal: On day gengwu in the eleventh month, he hunted and drank at a forester's home for four days altogether.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the eleventh month he hunted and drank at a forester's home for four days altogether.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，射野鹿，賜虞人物有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi in the eleventh month, he shot wild deer and granted the foresters gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the eleventh month he shot wild deer and granted the foresters gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，殺彘人曷主。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, he killed pig keeper Hezhu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he killed pig keeper Hezhu.
